name: ai.heliyos/heliyos-mcp
title: Heliyos
description: Heliyos, the AI operating system for revenue: records, notes, tasks, Scouts and AI workers.

environmentVariables.name: HELIYOS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Heliyos API key (starts with heliyos_). Create one in Heliyos under Settings, API keys.

environmentVariables.name: HELIYOS_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Heliyos API base URL. Leave unset for production.

environmentVariables.name: HELIYOS_MCP_EXPERIMENTAL
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to add the experimental tools (record enrichment, custom object create, update and delete).
